description: A false-colour satellite image (1/2/3 Band Combination) captured on 2012-09-07, illustrating the delineation of landscape features in Catalonia, Spain. The image displays a patchwork of land cover types segmented by numerous thin, white lines representing land parcel or feature boundaries. Vegetation appears in shades of dark red and reddish-brown, indicating strong near-infrared reflectance. Areas of bare ground or sparse vegetation are visible in lighter, almost white tones. A distinct, dark blue, triangular-shaped water body (likely a pond or reservoir) is present in the lower right quadrant. A faint, light blue line suggesting a small stream or drainage channel is visible in the upper left. The image is credited to CCME 2012, provided under Copernicus by the European Union and European Space Agency (ESA), and serves to exemplify the delineation process for mapping features within a technical guideline.
